opening_hypothesis_that_was_WRONG.claim_1: cost_ledger router was unmounted since W6 CP2 and frontend CostLedger.jsx never actually reached backend.
opening_hypothesis_that_was_WRONG.claim_2: server.py has a fatal import break (services.northena.trace_lens missing) that prevents application boot; the wave-close cohort never caught it because there is no boot test.
opening_hypothesis_that_was_WRONG.why_the_hypothesis_was_wrong: I confused Extraction-Akki's spine `backend/server.py` (a code-file that lives on programme/track-a but is NOT the runtime entrypoint) with the actual runtime pod-shell at `/app/backend/server.py`. The pod-shell inserts the spine backend path onto sys.path and imports SPECIFIC routers from the spine — not the spine's server.py. Discovered via `sudo supervisorctl status` + tail on /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log which showed backend RUNNING with clean 'Application startup complete' at pid 20690 immediately before my inspection.

corrected_honest_state.spine_bridge_mechanism: Pod-shell inserts '/app/assessment_workspace/repos/Extraction-Akki/backend' at sys.path[0], then imports individual routers by dotted path (e.g., `from services.cost_ledger.router import router as cost_ledger_router`).
corrected_honest_state.cost_ledger_actually_mounted_at_pod-shel: YES — /app/backend/server.py L36 imports and L172 include_router's it. Frontend CostLedger.jsx works.
corrected_honest_state.spine_server_py_trace_lens_break: That file exists as a historical/tests assembler but is not the runtime entrypoint. Its import defect has no runtime consequence and would only surface if someone imported the spine server.py directly — which the wave-close cohort correctly does not do.

actual_finding_at_W7_CP7.description: When I authored the 4 new W7 routers (model_registry, model_admission, baseline_line, model_recheck), I added include_router() calls to the SPINE's server.py — but NOT to the pod-shell. Runtime never saw the routers until the pod-shell mount was added at 2026-08-26T00:42Z.
actual_finding_at_W7_CP7.reasoning: This IS the FL-P4-W4-01 defect class — glue not touched at the same time as the artifact. Every wave adding a new service router MUST touch /app/backend/server.py at the two extension points (import block + include_router block). Same-commit-DoD extension.
actual_finding_at_W7_CP7.reconciliation: Pod-shell now imports + mounts model_registry_router, model_admission_router, baseline_line_router, model_recheck_router.
